fixer.title: Refine chat session indicators and add topology telemetry

cases.mechanism: An infinite CSS animation changed a large blurred box-shadow on a pseudo-element covering the entire chat widget while each request was in progress, forcing continuous rendering/paint work until completion.
cases.symptom: Sustained CPU/GPU paint load and potential dropped frames while a chat request runs, especially for large chat editor surfaces or multiple simultaneously visible sessions.
cases.fixedBehavior: In-progress sessions no longer create or animate the full-widget pseudo-element; only static idle-unvisited and needs-input frames remain, eliminating the continuous large-area box-shadow repaint during long-running requests.
cases.evidence: The base CSS applies `animation: chat-session-working-glow 1.4s ease-in-out infinite` to the full-widget `.interactive-session.chat-state-in-progress::before` overlay. The keyframes animate `box-shadow` from spacing-size20 to spacing-size60, so every active chat request continuously repaints a large blurred region for the request lifetime. This PR deletes both the in-progress pseudo-element selector and the infinite box-shadow animation, while `ChatWidget.updateSessionStateIndicator` still transitions request state normally.
